description: Points de charge pour véhicules électriques (IRVE) en Pays de la Loire - Consolidé par TEO is a dataset listed in data.teo-paysdelaloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by data.gouv.fr. Chaque ligne correspond à un point de charge. Accéder à ces mêmes données sur TerriSTORY Méthodologie de consolidation de ce jeu de données par TEO à l'échelle des Pays de la Loire Le jeu national Fichier consolidé des Bornes de Recharge pour Véhicules Électriques regroupe l’essentielle des sources disparates de données sur les IRVE (voir ... Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are TEO, Energie-Climat, Mobilité, diffusé sur data.gouv.fr. The portal shows 2,751 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-teo-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
